start: Owner signed in. Member detail of a member, card 'Workout plans'; the gym has plans

steps.action: Tap 'Send a plan'
user_sees: Sheet 'Send a plan to <member name>'
'Members see it in the MettleUp app after one check-in at the gym.'
'Your gym’s plans': each plan with its size, who it goes to and 'Send'
'Or make one for them': 'Start from a ready plan', 'Make a new plan'
must_not: The button usable with no internet

steps.action: Tap a plan
user_sees: 'Sending…' on that row, the other rows greyed
The sheet closes
A bar '“<plan>” sent to <member name>.' with Undo
must_not: Other members ticked on the plan taken off

start: Owner signed in, in 'Send a plan to <member name>'

steps.action: Tap 'Start from a ready plan'
user_sees: Title 'Start from a ready plan', the ready plans and 'Start empty', button '‹ Back'
must_not: The member dropped from the plan being made

steps.action: Tap a ready plan
user_sees: The builder 'New workout plan' with this member ticked under 'Send to'

steps.action: Tap 'Save plan'
user_sees: Toast '“<plan>” sent to <member name>.'
must_not: 'sent to' when the member was unticked before saving (then it reads '“<plan>” saved.')

steps.action: Open 'Send a plan' again and tap 'Make a new plan'
user_sees: An empty builder with this member ticked

start: Owner signed in, sending cannot go the normal way

steps.action: Open 'Send a plan' for a member who already gets a plan
user_sees: That plan greyed with a pill 'Already sent'

steps.action: Open it in a gym with no plans
user_sees: Only 'Make one for them' with its two rows

steps.action: Tap a plan that someone else changed a moment ago
user_sees: Red banner 'Someone else changed this plan while you had it open. Close it and open it again to see their changes.' (or 'Could not send this plan. Try again.')
The sheet stays open

steps.action: Open Member detail in a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Members get these plans only once your gym is online (Settings → Sign-in & data).' in the sheet
must_not: Words promising the member will see it

steps.action: Open Member detail in a gym whose MettleUp plan does not include trainer plans (when plan limits are on)
user_sees: One note about Pro in place of the 'Workout plans' card
must_not: A 'Send a plan' button that then fails

start: Owner signed in, a plan just sent in one tap

steps.action: Tap Undo on the bar within 8 seconds
user_sees: The bar goes; the member is off the plan again

steps.action: Send the plan again and wait 8 seconds
user_sees: The bar goes by itself; the plan stays sent
must_not: The plan taken back when the bar goes

steps.action: Open 'Send a plan' again
user_sees: That plan shows 'Already sent'

steps.action: Tap Undo after someone else changed the plan
user_sees: 'Someone changed “<plan>” just now. To take <member name> off it, open it under Workout plans.'

start: Owner signed in, sending a plan to one member

steps.action: Send a plan and read the sheet's lines
user_sees: Each plan's 'who it goes to' summary; only this member is added
must_not: Names or numbers of the plan's other members listed in the sheet
The member seeing the plan before a check-in at the gym, or a member of another gym seeing it
The plan staying on offer to a member whose data was deleted (unknown: not read)
